fee_notes: Royalty is 5.5% of Gross Revenues or Minimum Royalty, whichever is greater; no Minimum Royalty during first 6 months of operation. Minimum Royalty escalates over time: $550/mo (Jul–Dec 2025), $825/mo (2026), $1,100/mo (2027), $1,375/mo (2028), $1,650/mo (2029). Franchisees who accept waived Initial Franchise Fee under Franchise Option Program pay 9.5% royalty for initial 5-year term and first renewal term. Technology Fee is up to $1,000/mo (currently ~$600/mo). Brand Fund Fee is 2% of Gross Revenues per month. Additional ongoing fees include: Workshop Fee $300–$800/attendee; National Accounts Program Administrator Fee 1%–5% of invoiced amount (optional); Payment Processing Services $35/mo per account plus transaction fees; Accounting Software License $51.75/license/mo; Customer Management Software $70/license/mo (must purchase 2 licenses); Website Fee $150/website/mo; Agentic Customer Assistance Services $0.75–$2.50/conversation (optional); Email Marketing Services $169/mo for up to 5,000 emails (optional); Postcard Marketing Services $199/mo for up to 120 postcards (optional); Phone and Messaging Services $34.99/mo per user (optional); Email License Fee $15/mo; Digital Marketing Services $179–$595/mo (optional); Digital Lead Generation Services 20% of ad spend or $100 (whichever greater); Coop Advertising as agreed; Convention Fee up to $1,500/attendee; Late Fees 12% interest plus $100/occurrence; Audit cost $1,000–$15,000 if triggered.

Royalty 5.5% of Gross Revenues or the Minimum Royalty, whichever is greater. Due monthly on the last business day of the month or the 15th day of the month. See Note 1. The "Royalty" is based on "Gross Revenues" during the previous month. The "Minimum Royalty" is calculated based on the length of time you have been operating your Miracle Method Business. No Minimum Royalty is due during the first six months of operation of your Miracle Method Business. See Note 2.
Brand Fund Fee 2% of Gross Revenues, per month ("Brand Fund Fee") Due monthly on the last business day of the month or the 15th day of the month Payable in the month you commence operation of the Miracle Method Business in the Territory.
Technology Fee Our then-current fee, up to $1,000 per month (currently approximately $600 per month) Due by the 10th day of the month. You will be responsible for any increase in fees that result from any upgrades, modifications or additional software or from increases from third-party vendors. See Notes 4 and 10.
